keywords: EIP-8037 calldata 底价修复合并
Robinhood Chain 与 ETH 作为 gas 代币
summary: 周六。jochem-brouwer 提交的 EIP-8037 修复合并，calldata 底价计入区块级 gas 记账。Barnabé 认为 1 亿美元流入 Robinhood Chain 不是因为 ETH 是其 gas 代币，而是因为 ETH 是以太坊的货币；他还引用一项新研究称以太坊验证者网络约有 8,500 个物理节点。Vitalik 评论 AI 2040 与批评者的世界观完全不相容。

items.title: EIP-8037：把 EIP-7976 calldata 底价应用到区块级 gas 记账
items.note: 合并。复现测试在 Amsterdam 规则、`block_gas_limit = 2 * TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT = 33,554,432` 的设置下测量 calldata 底价预算。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: apply the EIP-7976 calldata floor to block-level gas accounting
items.note_en: Merged. Its reproduction test measures the calldata floor budget under Amsterdam rules with `block_gas_limit = 2 * TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT = 33,554,432`.

items.title: Barnabé：约 8,500 个验证者物理节点
items.note: 03:52，引用 alexneumueller 的新研究；2024 年 Brown 与 Bautista-Gomez 的论文记录约 12,000 个节点，其中约 7,000 个验证者节点。
items.title_en: Barnabé: about 8,500 physical nodes in the validator network
items.note_en: 03:52, citing a new study by alexneumueller; a 2024 paper by Brown and Bautista-Gomez recorded about 12,000 nodes, about 7,000 of them validator nodes.

items.title: Barnabé：1 亿美元流入 Robinhood Chain 不是因为 ETH 是 gas 代币
items.note: 21:40，让 ETH 做 gas 代币是最面向未来的决定，但 gas 支出很小，真正原因是 ETH 是以太坊的货币。
items.title_en: Barnabé: $100 million did not bridge to Robinhood Chain because ETH is its gas token
items.note_en: 21:40; making ETH the gas token is the most future-proof decision, but gas spent is trivial, and the real reason is that ETH is the money of Ethereum.

keywords_en: Robinhood Chain and ETH as gas token
summary_en: Saturday. jochem-brouwer's EIP-8037 fix was merged, bringing the calldata floor into block-level gas accounting. Barnabé argued that $100 million flowed to Robinhood Chain not because ETH is its gas token but because ETH is the money of Ethereum, and cited a new study counting about 8,500 physical nodes in Ethereum's validator network. Vitalik commented that AI 2040 and its detractors hold totally incompatible worldviews.
